description: This Python script implements machine learning functionalities for training, saving, loading, and using a RandomForest model to predict user activity schedules and shutdown recommendations. It includes functions for feature extraction, model persistence, and inference, tailored for usage prediction per user.

classes.name: ModelMetadata
classes.description: Schema for storing metadata about the trained model, including version, creation timestamp, feature names, and other properties.

classes.name: ScheduleSlot
classes.description: Schema representing a scheduled time slot.

classes.name: ShutdownRecommendation
classes.description: Schema containing information about shutdown recommendations, including probabilities and hours.

classes.name: TrainingExample
classes.description: Schema for a training data point, including features and label.

methods.description: Trains and saves a RandomForest model based on provided training examples, and returns model metadata and evaluation report.

methods.description: Generates feature vector from a datetime object for inference.

methods.name: ShutdownRecommendation predict_hourly_week_schedule( user_id: str, instance_id: str, threshold: float = 0.3, )
methods.description: Predicts hourly shutdown probabilities over a week and recommends hours to shut down based on a threshold.
